data.llm_user_prompt:
# CONTEXT:
You are an agent playing a dynamic game. Your objective is to
WIN and avoid GAME_OVER while minimizing actions.

# TURN:
Call exactly one action.

llm_tools.name: ACTION6
llm_tools.description: Send complex input action (6, Click, Point).

llm_tools.name: execute_plan
llm_tools.description: Execute a SHORT sequence of game actions (max 3) WITHOUT pausing for observation between each step. Use this for navigation when you have a clear path. Execution stops early if: (1) an action has no effect (wall hit), (2) score changes, or (3) game state changes.

actions.description: Comma-separated list of actions. E.g., 'ACTION2,ACTION2,ACTION3'. Max 3.

llm_tools.name: navigate_to
llm_tools.description: PREFERRED navigation method. Uses BFS pathfinding to compute the shortest path to a target position, automatically avoiding known walls. ALWAYS use this instead of manually chaining ACTION1-ACTION4 when you know where to go. The path executes automatically, stopping on wall hit or score change.

llm_tools.name: update_game_notes
llm_tools.description: Record discovered game knowledge to your persistent skill file. Use this to save confirmed action mappings, game rules, level strategies, object roles, or tips. Knowledge persists across retries.

content.description: The knowledge to record, in markdown format.
